from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper extracted from the current document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper (the document itself)")
    references_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers cited in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parser output for a single document."""
    papers: list[Paper]
